title: ETF Flow Breakout Continuation
rationale: Tests whether a simple rolling-high breakout can measure short-term ETF flow persistence without adding new indicators or freeform parameters.
tests_claim: A prespecified ETF breakout rule can capture continuing flow pressure after a new short-term high while exiting on a rolling-low failure.
known_limitations: This currently reuses the fixed 20-day breakout and 10-day exit channel from the executable breakout-trend template.
A successful result would support only this measurable breakout proxy, not the full ETF-flow thesis.
The current campaign engine does not yet filter candidate symbols by opportunity-thesis universe.
